first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: Dark blue open-wheel race car; the nose, front wheels, and suspension are visible in the first segment, and the cockpit and protective frame with a central pillar are visible after the cut.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The broad gray paved surface ahead of Vehicle A, curving to the right, with a gentler curve in the later segment.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: The light blue sky above the trees and racetrack facilities.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person in Vehicle A's driving position; only both hands wearing dark blue gloves and parts of the forearms are visible.

entities.name: multi-button steering wheel
entities.identification: The black irregularly shaped steering wheel held by Person A, with colored buttons, circular knobs, and a silver-gray concave curved upper edge.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The narrow, segmented off-white and pale red paved strip at the right edge of the road surface.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The low green grass strips and lawns outside the road.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The clusters and rows of green trees around the outside of the road.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: The continuous low walls and protective sections around the outside of the road; the right side is mainly a light-colored wall, while the left side has a green advertising surface and a distant orange area.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The fence around the outside of the road, composed of gray-black vertical posts, horizontal connecting lines, and fine mesh.

entities.name: cross-track gantry
entities.identification: The long, dark green gantry in the distance ahead and to the right, partially overlapping the nearer mesh fence.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The set of green rectangular advertising surfaces and upright rectangular large screens beside the road.

entities.name: cockpit instrument display
entities.identification: The fixed black rectangular digital display above and behind the multi-button steering wheel, with indicator lights along its upper edge.
